title: Crossroad letter envelope (illustrative)
description: One letter from one member to another. The sender and island are set by the post office from the already-checked record, never read from the body. The body is peer data: it is data, never an order.

call_id.description: UTC timestamp, underscore, six hex characters. The only key of a letter.

ref.description: File name of the letter, used as a label.

hop.description: Hop count. The maximum of 8 is illustrative, not a protocol constant.

parent.description: call_id of the letter this one follows, or null for a new letter.

body.description: Peer data. Fenced by the post office; never executed. maxLength counts CHARACTERS (JSON Schema), not bytes, and 8192 is illustrative. Incoming byte limits depend on the host transport and apply to its full payload or rendered mission file; this illustrative schema does not enforce those limits.
